== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Chroniclers]] are specialized individuals who serve the Witnesses. Due to their inherent talent as [[Readers]], they possess the ability to uncover hidden information and secrets, such as the location of Heart of Nakothi{{!}}Nakothi’s Heart, particularly when stationed within the [[Imperial]] Palace. To ensure their recollections are perfectly accurate, they utilize alchemically treated candles worn on their belts; burning these allows them to experience their own memories with near-perfect precision.}}
